Ergonomically designed soft-grip handle for additional control whilst working. Perfect knuckle clearance between handle and blade for comfort. Handle is riveted to the blade for maximum strength. Blade constructed from a high-grade tempered carbon steel for durability and flexibility. Lacquered for additional protection against rust and corrosion. Engineered to achieve ideal balance for additional comfort and to reduce fatigue.
